bandReport.notes: Full expected range 56-70 present, exactly once each, no gaps. Q66 and Q68 DO exist on p12 and are transcribed here: the OCR text layer missed them only because the booklet sets their numbers with an internal space ('6 6 .' and '6 8 .'), so a number-prefix scan skips them. An OCR artifact, not a gap in the paper. Q56 opens p10 cleanly as a fresh question; Q70's option block ends well above the foot of p12's right column and nothing spills overleaf. p11's OCR interleaves the Q62 and Q64 option blocks across the two columns (it emits '(a) Surya Sukta ... (b) Purusha Sukta / (Cl) / (b) / Germany / Japan / (c) Dana Stutis / (c) Denmark / (d) Uma Sutra / (d) Italy'); both option sets were re-read from the page image at 6x and assigned to their own column. Nothing on these three pages belongs to a neighbouring band.
